log_cleanup.desc: 回滚到任务解析节点，重新生成只备份不删除的安全代码

input.reason: 危险删除和审计证据保留约束冲突

log_cleanup.desc: 根据冲突核心重新生成安全脚本，仅复制和压缩日志文件
log_cleanup.code:
from pathlib import Path
import shutil

source_dir = Path('/var/log')
backup_dir = Path('/tmp/audit_backup')
backup_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

for path in source_dir.glob('*.log'):
    shutil.copy2(path, backup_dir / path.name)
print('audit logs backed up')

constraints.formula:

(declare-const ctx_allowed_read Bool)
(declare-const ctx_allowed_copy Bool)
(declare-const ctx_allowed_compress Bool)
(declare-const code_op_read Bool)
(declare-const code_op_copy Bool)
(declare-const code_op_compress Bool)
(declare-const code_op_delete Bool)
(declare-const code_op_shell Bool)
(declare-const code_op_network Bool)

(assert ctx_allowed_copy)
(assert ctx_allowed_compress)
(assert code_op_read)
(assert code_op_copy)
(assert code_op_compress)
(assert (not code_op_delete))
(assert (not code_op_shell))
(assert (not code_op_network))
(assert (=> code_op_read ctx_allowed_read))
(assert (=> code_op_copy ctx_allowed_copy))
(assert (=> code_op_compress ctx_allowed_compress))

(set-logic QF_UF)

(declare-const code_deletes_audit_evidence Bool)
(declare-const code_overwrites_audit_evidence Bool)

                (not code_overwrites_audit_evidence))))
(assert (=> ctx_require_audit_evidence_ok audit_evidence_ok))
